rubriker.title: Sindarov Pulling Ahead of Gukesh With 72 Rating
rubriker._rss_content: Sindarov leads Gukesh by 72 rating points on FIDE’s November list and has just won Clutch Chess. Now the World Championship awaits.

rubriker.title: Bavarian Championship: Few surprises in the opening rounds at Tegernsee
rubriker._rss_content: Fifty players remain on perfect scores after two rounds of the Bavarian Chess Championship, which has attracted 548 participants to Gmund am Tegernsee. Most of the leading seeds have made a strong start, though Jaime Santos, Leonardo Costa and Peter Acs - all among the top ten in the starting rank - were held to draws by lower-rated opponents. Top seed Frederik Svane (pictured) and third seed Alexander Donchenko are among those sharing the lead with 2/2 points. | Photo: Sandra Schmidt/OIBM

rubriker.title: Vasily Panov: An influential theoretician with a dark side
rubriker._rss_content: Born on 1 November 1906, Vasily Panov was not among the leading Soviet chess players of his generation. However, he was a prominent figure as an author and theoretician. Many players know his name as the inventor of the Panov Attack, which was named after him. Yet Panov's career also had a darker side.
